title: Daily Keltner upper-band close breakout in uptrend, exit at EMA20
rule_summary: Daily signals from closed daily candles, executed at the next 1h open. Keltner mid = EMA(20) of daily close; ATR(20) simple/Wilder average of daily true range; upper band = mid + 1.5*ATR(20). ENTRY when a daily close is above the upper band, the previous daily close was at or below the previous upper band (fresh cross), daily close > SMA(100), and no position is open. EXIT when a daily close falls below EMA(20), or close is 2.0*ATR(20) (at entry) below the entry price (stop checked on daily closes). Source uses 1.5 band multiplier and 20-length; I adapted the lower-band reversion idea into a trend breakout on the upside, so the rule is my own.
mechanism: A close beyond 1.5 ATR above the 20-day mean marks a volatility expansion; slower participants and stop-driven sellers/short covers chase it over following days, so the move tends to continue until price falls back to the mean. Source gives no mechanism for the breakout direction; this is the closest honest one.
